# ATS repository instructions

Before substantive work, read `AI_HANDOFF.md` and `AGENTS.md`.

Use `03_СОСТОЯНИЕ_ПРОЕКТА.yaml` as the canonical machine-readable program state, `02_СЛЕДУЮЩИЙ_ШАГ.md` for the immediate next action, and `governance/backlog/PROGRAM_BACKLOG_V2.md` for the execution queue.

Current ATS v2 governance lives in `governance/program/` and `governance/methodology/`.

Do not treat `legacy/v1/` or the G01–G13 model as the current program roadmap or source of trading permission.
